title: CORE-05 Generic Workflows & Model Qualification Matrix Explorer in Companion Console
purpose: Activate the Workflows and Model Qualification Matrix Explorer views in the Companion Console UI (and update Unified Shell), allowing operators to view, configure, and trigger all 4 core generic workflows (repo_review, text_qa, document_review, content_os), inspect multi-tier qualified local models across generic capabilities, and test shadow routing with fallback recommendations live from the browser.
problem: Generic workflows and multi-tier model qualification matrix are tested hermetically via scripts, but the companion console still disables the Workflows tab, only supports Lighthouse Handoff, and lacks an interactive explorer for qualified models, fallback chains, and workflow execution.

excluded: Breaking changes to existing Lighthouse validation runner

acceptanceCriteria.description: Companion console navigation activates Workflows and Model Matrix tabs alongside Run.
Companion console lists all 4 generic multi-track workflows (repo_review, text_qa, document_review, content_os) with their track pipelines and input schemas.
Operators can select a generic workflow, supply inputs, trigger execution via /workflows/run, and inspect step-by-step progress and output artifacts.
Model Qualification Matrix Explorer visualizes all 4 qualified models across generic capabilities with role tiers and checksum status.
Matrix Explorer provides an interactive test utility calling /qualifications/dry-run to test prompt classification, routing recommendations, and fallback candidate display.
All existing test suites (npm run test:full) continue to pass 100% green.
